protocol.hardware: identical for both teams in each game
protocol.note: Local fixed-seed development comparisons at 420 seconds. The cumulative summary mixes two candidate source versions; see version_summaries. All sides used the default 2027 lineup, including the trident opponent rebound to that lineup. Not an independent generalization estimate.

summary_scope: Cumulative development history across two candidate versions; not the frozen published version alone.

evaluation_scope.other_styles: tech_overload and hunter share the controller and are checked separately for generation integrity and short runtime compatibility; these eight full games do not measure their win rates.

validation.smoke_scope: Runtime compatibility only; excluded from all full-game win totals.
